title: Wrong Number

pre.en: Who did the stranger turn out to be?

intro: 一段深夜的聊天记录：一条发错的消息，让 Chen 给一个素不相识的人出起了面试的主意。读的时候留意提建议的几种说法——should、ought to、had better、Why don't you …?——语气有轻有重，对谁说、怎么说都不一样。

sentences.en: Jess, I'm so nervous about tomorrow!
sentences.zh: Jess，明天的事我好紧张！
sentences.speaker: Liam

sentences.en: Should I wear the blue shirt?
sentences.zh: 我该穿那件蓝衬衫吗？

sentences.en: Sorry, I think you've sent this to me by mistake.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，你好像发错人了。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I'm not Jess.
sentences.zh: 我不是 Jess。

sentences.en: Oh no, sorry!
sentences.zh: 哎呀，对不起！
sentences.speaker: Liam

sentences.en: She must be fast asleep anyway.
sentences.zh: 反正她这会儿肯定早睡熟了。

sentences.en: My interview's at ten, and I can't fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 我明天十点面试，可怎么都睡不着。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没事。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You must be really nervous.
sentences.zh: 你肯定特别紧张吧。

sentences.en: Why don't you tell me about it?
sentences.zh: 要不跟我说说？

sentences.en: Really? Thanks.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？谢谢。
sentences.speaker: Liam

sentences.en: It's a developer job at a tech company.
sentences.zh: 是一家科技公司的开发岗。

sentences.en: What if they ask about my weaknesses?
sentences.zh: 要是他们问我有什么缺点，怎么办？

sentences.en: First, calm down.
sentences.zh: 先别慌。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: You should practise a short answer about yourself.
sentences.zh: 你应该先练一段简短的自我介绍。

sentences.en: It's also worth preparing two good questions for the interviewer.
sentences.zh: 再准备两个好问题留着问面试官，也很值得。

sentences.en: And you'd better not talk too fast — I always do when I'm nervous.
sentences.zh: 还有，说话千万别太快——我一紧张就这样。

sentences.en: Good idea, I'll give it a try.
sentences.zh: 好主意，我试试。
sentences.speaker: Liam

sentences.en: But blue or grey?
sentences.zh: 可到底穿蓝的还是灰的？

sentences.en: I can't make up my mind!
sentences.zh: 我实在拿不定主意！

sentences.en: Blue.
sentences.zh: 蓝的。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: And iron it.
sentences.zh: 记得熨一下。

sentences.en: Smile when you walk in — it always breaks the ice.
sentences.zh: 进门的时候笑一笑——一笑气氛就松下来了。

sentences.en: And don't give up if they ask a hard question.
sentences.zh: 碰上难题也别轻易放弃。

sentences.en: Thanks for the pep talk, stranger!
sentences.zh: 谢谢你给我打气，陌生人！
sentences.speaker: Liam

sentences.en: Wish me luck.
sentences.zh: 祝我好运吧。

sentences.en: Good luck!
sentences.zh: 祝你好运！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Now you really ought to get some sleep.
sentences.zh: 现在你真该去睡会儿了。

sentences.en: If you don't, you'll look like a zombie.
sentences.zh: 不然明天你就跟个僵尸似的。

sentences.en: Hi, it's Liam, the wrong number!
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是 Liam，就是那个发错消息的！
sentences.speaker: Liam

sentences.en: It went well — I got the job!
sentences.zh: 面试很顺利——我被录用了！

sentences.en: No way!
sentences.zh: 太厉害了！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Congratulations!
sentences.zh: 恭喜恭喜！

sentences.en: Make sure you thank Jess for her great advice.
sentences.zh: 记得好好谢谢 Jess 的「金玉良言」哦。

sentences.en: Morning!
sentences.zh: 早！
sentences.speaker: Liam

sentences.en: It's my first day today, and the team seems really nice.
sentences.zh: 今天第一天上班，同事们看着都挺好的。

sentences.en: I think I'll get along with them.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我能跟他们处得来。

sentences.en: Wait, is that you in your profile picture?
sentences.zh: 等等，你头像上那个是你吗？

sentences.en: Yes, why?
sentences.zh: 是啊，怎么了？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Look up.
sentences.zh: 抬头。
sentences.speaker: Liam

sentences.en: Blue shirt, by the coffee machine.
sentences.zh: 咖啡机旁边，穿蓝衬衫的那个。

sentences.en: I think we've already met.
sentences.zh: 咱俩好像已经认识了。

cards.note: to feel worried and a little afraid about something that is going to happen
cards.tip: about 后面接名词或 doing：nervous about the interview / about speaking。说「让人紧张的事」不用 nervous，用 stressful：a stressful day。
cards.example: I'm always nervous about speaking English in big meetings.

cards.note: without intending to, because of an error
to start sleeping
面试常问 What are your strengths and weaknesses?（你有什么长处和短处）。
to stop feeling upset, angry or nervous
cards.tip: 对正在气头上的人直接说 Calm down! 常常适得其反；温和一点可以说 Don't worry 或 Take your time。
cards.example: Let's all calm down and look at the logs again.

cards.note: used to say that something is good or useful enough to spend time or money on
cards.tip: worth 后面接 doing，不接 to do：worth preparing，不说 worth to prepare。
cards.example: It's worth reading the docs before you change the code.

cards.note: -er 是提问的人，-ee 是被问的人：interviewer 面试官，interviewee 面试者。
to try doing something to see if it works or if you like it
cards.tip: it 指要试的那件事；英式口语也常说 give it a go，美式常说 give it a shot。
cards.example: The new framework looks hard, but let's give it a try.

cards.note: to decide something, especially after thinking about it for a long time
cards.tip: your 要跟着主语变：make up my mind、make up her mind；也可以说 make my mind up。
cards.example: I still can't make up my mind about the job offer.

cards.note: 名词是「熨斗」，也是「铁」；读 /ˈaɪən/，r 不发音。

cards.zh: 打破沉默；（跟陌生人）打开话匣子
cards.note: to say or do something that helps people relax when they meet for the first time
to stop trying to do something because it is too difficult
cards.tip: 放弃某事：give up sth / give up doing sth；代词要放中间：give it up。
cards.example: Don't give up on that bug — we're very close.

cards.note: 别人紧张、泄气时的一番鼓励；give sb a pep talk 给某人打气。
直接管对方叫 stranger，是熟络的玩笑口吻，像中文的「这位陌生朋友」。
to say that you hope someone will be successful
cards.tip: 考试、面试、比赛之前常说 Wish me luck!；回一句 Good luck! 最自然，I wish you good luck 听起来偏正式。
cards.example: We all wished her luck before her first big presentation.

cards.note: 口语里形容人没睡好、无精打采：I'm a zombie this morning.
to happen in the way that you hoped
cards.tip: 主语是事情，不是人：The interview went well，不说 I went well。问「怎么样了」用 How did it go?
cards.example: How did the demo go? — Really well, thanks.

cards.note: to do or check something so that you are certain it happens
cards.tip: 后面直接接句子：make sure you …；提醒别人时放句首，语气比 must 柔和。
cards.example: Make sure you save your work before the update.

cards.note: to have a friendly relationship with someone
聊天软件、社交软件里的头像，口语常缩成 profile pic。
